readiness_failure.root_cause: The report's evidence:findings package contained factual candidates without valid evidence references; the research-methodology candidate was also included in rendered HTML. The deterministic readiness gate detected one untrusted rendered item and blocked the report.
readiness_failure.relationship_to_concurrency_change: No telemetry links the missing evidence reference to the grounding concurrency cap. The grounding batches all completed successfully. This run cannot establish whether stochastic report content is causally related to the implementation commits.

pre_fix_comparison.causal_attribution_limit: These are single-cohort observations. Generated content and resulting call counts vary; provider request timing by family is unavailable, so the measured deltas do not isolate the concurrency change as the sole cause of the speedup.

versus_original_baseline.causal_attribution_limit: Single-cohort measurements; provider timing by stage/family is unavailable, so these deltas do not isolate grounding concurrency as the sole cause.

failed_criteria: One untrusted factual evidence item was present in rendered HTML.
pre_fix_acceptance.reliability_result: grounding limiter and duplicate-execution checks passed; one readiness-blocked report prevents overall quality acceptance
pre_fix_acceptance.performance_result: material observed improvement; cohort wall reduced 19.28%, report_analysis total reduced 25.34%, max reduced 30.37%, and cost decreased 1.22%
pre_fix_acceptance.decision: Do not mark the optimization accepted for production promotion on this benchmark. Leave commits 6328b931 and f15ba3f5 in the current branch pending a separate evidence-fidelity correction and its required validation. Do not lower the shared cap: the observed quality failure is a missing evidence reference, and there is no evidence that cap=5 caused it or that a lower cap would fix it.
pre_fix_acceptance.next_measured_bottleneck: report_analysis remains the largest measured execution stage (1830.36 seconds total, 901 seconds queue wait). Within its provider-call volume, figure_ranking is highest at 43 calls, followed by evidence_pack_primary at 30. Per-family provider latency was not retained, so the next profiling step should add timing attribution before making another optimization.

acceptance.evidence_fidelity_lifecycle: Across five reports, 65 unsupported factual candidates remained in audit records; none reappeared by ID in canonical findings or reusable findings materializations, and no rejected candidate text appeared in rendered HTML.
acceptance.grounding_regression_protection: 31 unique grounding tasks completed across all five reports without duplicate task ids or provider errors/429s/timeouts. The pre-fix run directly observed a process-wide peak of 5 with active overlap. The follow-up did not retain per-call start/finish or limiter-counter telemetry, so its peak cannot be independently recomputed.
acceptance.performance_result: No specified regression threshold was triggered versus the latest pre-fix reference; wall time, report-analysis total and max, provider calls, and cost all decreased. Performance remains materially improved versus the original baseline.
acceptance.decision: Accept the grounding optimization after the evidence-fidelity correction and retain the shared grounding cap at 5. Do not do more outer-concurrency work.
acceptance.next_measured_bottleneck: Add minimal provider request start/finish timing by report-analysis stage and prompt family. Current report_analysis execution was 1736.637 seconds with 824 seconds queue wait, but provider_request_timing and prompt_family_elapsed_time are unavailable; do not rank figure_ranking or evidence packs from call counts alone.
